match_nodes.description: Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados

data.official_name: Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados
data.description: Brazil's general data protection law (Law 13.709/2018), modeled on GDPR.

Brazil's foundational internet-rights law, sanctioned April 23, 2014 -- often called the 'Constitution of the Internet.' Establishes net neutrality, freedom of expression online, and privacy/personal-data protection principles predating the LGPD (secid:regulation/planalto.gov.br/lgpd). Regulated further by Decreto 8.771/2016.

match_nodes.description: Brazilian AI Bill (Marco Legal da IA) — pending legislation

data.description: Comprehensive AI-regulation bill modeled on the EU AI Act: risk-tiered classification (excessive/high/low-moderate risk), rights for affected persons (transparency, explanation, contestation), creation of a National AI Regulation and Governance System (SIA), and fines up to R$50 million per violation.
data.notes: Status: Proposed (approved by the Federal Senate December 10, 2024; under review in the Chamber of Deputies Special Committee pending plenary vote; verified as of 2026-11-03). Revisit once sanctioned into law.

match_nodes.description: ECA Digital — Child and Adolescent Digital Protection Statute (Lei nº 15.211/2025)

data.official_name: Lei nº 15.211, de 17 de setembro de 2025 (Estatuto Digital da Criança e do Adolescente — ECA Digital)
alternate_names: Estatuto Digital da Criança e do Adolescente
data.description: Brazilian federal statute protecting children and adolescents in digital environments, establishing safety-by-design duties, privacy-preserving age assurance, parental supervision tools, and protection against emotional manipulation and harmful interactions across online platforms and conversational AI interfaces accessible to minors.
data.notes: Status: In force March 18, 2026 (enacted September 17, 2025; regulated by Decreto nº 12.880 of March 18, 2026, secid:regulation/planalto.gov.br/decreto-12880-2026; enforced by ANPD as lead administrative authority; verified as of 2026-11-03).

match_nodes.description: Decreto nº 12.880/2026 — Implementing Decree for the Child and Adolescent Digital Protection Statute (ECA Digital)

data.official_name: Decreto nº 12.880, de 18 de março de 2026 — Regulamenta a Lei nº 15.211, de 17 de setembro de 2025 (ECA Digital)
data.description: Brazilian presidential decree regulating Law 15.211/2025 (ECA Digital), designating the National Data Protection Authority (ANPD) as the lead administrative enforcement authority and establishing compliance obligations for digital services, conversational agents, large language models, and natural-language AI interfaces accessible to minors.
data.notes: Status: In force March 18, 2026 (signed March 18, 2026; implements secid:regulation/planalto.gov.br/eca-digital; verified as of 2026-11-03).
